title: Accenture Technology Vision 2012
notes: Six trends. Published date from PDF creation date (2012-01-17). The foreword says 'The technology that you use will be radically different three years from now.' Each trend has a 'This time next year / Over the next 12 months, the IT organization should' action list (recommendations, not forecasts). This is the edition held in Envisioning's archive.

entries.label: Context-based services
entries.quote: Context—where you are and what you’re doing—will drive the next wave of digital services
entries.subject: Context-aware services
entries.note: Horizon is edition-level: the Research Methodology says the team looks for developments with the greatest impact 'in the next few years'.
